means: A danbooru tag for an image whose subject is a thing rather than a person - the object is centred, lit and rendered as the point of the picture.
does: Puts the object at the centre of attention and lets shallow depth of field and rim light actually attach to it rather than to a face. Paired with no humans this is the highest-adherence shot type available on this box: no face, no character consistency risk, near-perfect prompt adherence, and about 4.5 seconds of GPU. It is also how you fake coverage, since no model here holds a persistent 3D space to cut around.
reach_for_it: inserts and cutaways - and reach for it more often than feels necessary, because it is the cheapest and least failure-prone shot in the project
used_in: prompts/anime_macro_insert.json, titled there 'the cheapest shot you can make'; the insert value of shot.purpose. craft/ANIME_EPISODE.md asks for one insert per act minimum and says to make it an object
example_base: 1boy, solo, male focus, short dark hair, plain jacket, standing, city street, daytime
read_it_as: Compare the SHADING, colour and line - not the pose or framing. Adding any clause re-rolls the model's conditioning, so composition moves between the two panels even at a fixed seed. An img2img pass from one fixed base image would isolate the tag properly; that is not built yet.
